cohort: 2,377 women who gave birth in the Netherlands
finding: Women who experienced an unplanned caesarean birth or instrumental birth, or reported less control during labour, were more likely to report a 'less than good' experience of midwifery care.
mod_finding: Women who experienced an unplanned caesarean birth or instrumental birth were more likely to report a 'less than good' experience of midwifery care.
